no-restricted-syntax.message: CANDID-031 (D6): $queryRaw bypasses piiExtension. Use prisma.user.findX, or call decryptUserPiiField() explicitly. If unavoidable, add `// eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-syntax -- <reason>` with a justified PR comment.
CANDID-031 (D6): $queryRaw bypasses piiExtension. Use prisma.user.findX, or call decryptUserPiiField() explicitly.

CANDID-031 (D6): $executeRaw bypasses piiExtension write guard (encryptUserPiiInput). Use prisma.user.update/create or call encryptPiiWithVersion() explicitly.
